column2: Assemble weapons which utilize electromagnets to catapult sabots up to hypervelocity, penetrating thick armor and piercing through targets alike. Note that these also require advanced components.
subject_story->mastered the physics of electromagnetic acceleration, creating weapons that launch projectiles at staggering speeds
subject_story->engineered mass drivers capable of breaching the most formidable armor, reshaping the principles of warfare and defense
subject_story->unveiled a new era where kinetic energy defines the cutting edge of military technology
